title: An attacker allowed to send AXFR or IXFR queries can cause an outgoing TCP connection to the backend to be stuck,…
description: CVE-2026-123755 is a vulnerability where an attacker permitted to send AXFR or IXFR DNS zone transfer queries can cause an outgoing TCP connection to the backend to become stuck. This results in a denial of service condition for other clients attempting to reuse the same connection. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3 and does not impact confidentiality or integrity but affects availability.
